list.name: inversor
list.label: Inversor
list.query: SELECT inverter_id FROM dw.dim_inversor ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts_utc AS time, 'inv_' || inverter_id AS metric, soc AS value FROM dw.fact_bateria_vivo WHERE $__timeFilter(ts_utc) AND inverter_id IN ($inversor) ORDER BY 1

SELECT now() AS time, 'inv_' || inverter_id AS metric, soc AS value FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (inverter_id) inverter_id, soc FROM dw.fact_bateria_vivo WHERE inverter_id IN ($inversor) ORDER BY inverter_id, ts_utc DESC) t
SELECT ts_utc AS time, 'inv_' || inverter_id AS metric, corriente_a AS value FROM dw.fact_bateria_vivo WHERE $__timeFilter(ts_utc) AND inverter_id IN ($inversor) ORDER BY 1

SELECT DISTINCT ON (v.inverter_id) v.inverter_id AS inversor, e.estado, v.soc, v.volt, v.corriente_a, v.ts_utc FROM dw.fact_bateria_vivo v JOIN dw.dim_estado_soc e ON v.soc >= e.soc_desde AND v.soc < e.soc_hasta WHERE v.inverter_id IN ($inversor) ORDER BY v.inverter_id, v.ts_utc DESC
